tasks.design: Configure native research-source links in {DOCS} and stable experiment fields in laboratory notebook and bioinformatics software {OTHER}. The biologist retains design, actual experiments/computations, observation and interpretation, then captures actual findings and checks the final notebook entry before committing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research can repeat source navigation and stable experiment identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and experiment templates can reduce repeated lookup/fields.
tasks.still_hard: Cellular mechanisms require actual experimentation and scientific interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises an observed signal that does not support the proposed mechanism.
tasks.altitude: Less research administration; scientific investigation remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research links and notebook templates can reduce repeated identifiers/navigation; they do not conduct cellular research or establish a mechanism.

assumptions: Actual publishers/lab owners supply sources and previous records, checked in s1. Biologist chooses actual design in s2 and performs actual research and primary observation in s3.

S4 cuts repeated stable experiment identifiers/headings only. Actual new methods, observations, interpretation capture and final completeness checking remain in retained 11.2 hours; no automatic outcome capture or free structured findings.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Experimental and computational research are alternative actual branches requiring reweighting. Native templates first; existing notebook automation and computational runtime earn zero saving.
Commit retains one percent using existing final check. Actual reporting under 23905 is counted once; no external release is assumed here.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce duplicate entry after complete experimental record checks?

already_counted.description: Capture actual research observations and check final record in s4.

incremental.description: Maintain actual experiment fields and source links.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual notebook entry and exact experiment destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 navigation + 14*0.20 repeated fields = 8.8; minus 1 upkeep = 7.8. Half eligible gives 4.4 minus 1 = 3.4. Actual research, capture/check and commit retained.

loop.why_not_simpler: Native venue headings, reference fields and figure links first; scientific explanations vary

tasks.design: Configure native figure/reference assembly in scientific reporting tools {OTHER} and {DOCS}, then bound prose drafting to actual findings. The biologist retains author choices and complete substantive review, then separately saves and sends only the exact permitted final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scientific communication can repeat assembly and prose after findings exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source-linked assembly and bounded drafting can reduce production.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific meaning and appropriate limitations require complete expert review.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises a polished account that overstates a cellular mechanism.
tasks.altitude: Less communication production; scientific review stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native scientific figure/reference assembly and bounded prose drafting can support communication preparation; they cannot establish scientific claims.

assumptions: Actual researchers produce checked findings, captured under research work; biologist selects actual content in s1. Actual reference metadata is verified; missing evidence remains manual. Retained s3 includes capture/correction of actual author meaning.

Preparation and review are alternative task branches. Review-only work retains complete review and actual review writing; unused assembly/draft branches must be removed and actual work reweighted, not assumed per review.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native assembly first; existing automated figures/references earn zero saving. Actual research/data production under 16815 is counted once.

Save/send each retain one percent using existing full final check after complete content exists. Actual coauthor/disclosure permissions must exist before send; no editorial acceptance or publication is inferred from delivery.
unknowns: Which scientific communication work is still manual?
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce production after complete scientific review?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct actual scientific communication meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual source links, venue fields and scientific drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual communication and exact internal destination; edits require recheck
s4 checked final actual communication/review and exact authorised recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 assembly + 25*0.30 prose = 15.5; minus 1.5 upkeep = 14. Half eligible gives 7.75 minus 1.5 = 6.25. Author choices, full review, save and send retained.

tasks.design: Configure native course/source links in {LMS} and {DOCS}. The biologist verifies actual objectives and sources, retains instruction, laboratory supervision and assessment, then captures/checks any actual required teaching record before committing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instruction preparation can repeat source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current course/source links can reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching and laboratory competence depend on student interaction and observation.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises conceptual misunderstanding or unsafe laboratory practice.
tasks.altitude: Less source preparation; instruction stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course/source links can support biology teaching preparation; they do not teach or assess student understanding.

assumptions: Actual course owners supply objectives/resources, checked in s1. Actual primary student observations and assessment decisions stay retained in s2/s3 and record capture/check stays in s4.

Preparation is counted once per actual new/revised session, not per student. Actual required teaching records only; if none required remove record branch and reweight rather than inventing administration.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing linked access earns zero saving. Routine commit retains one percent using existing final check; any separate material publication or written feedback delivery requires its own exact-final-version gated action.
research_questions: Can native links shorten preparation while preserving instruction and assessment?

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual teaching record and exact student/session destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 preparation lookup = 6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Half eligible gives 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5. Instruction, assessment, actual record work and commit retained.

tasks.design: Configure native request/resource/status views in {PROJECT} and laboratory information software {OTHER}, with source references in {DOCS}. The biologist checks actual availability, retains priorities and staff coordination, then captures/checks the final activity plan before separate commit and delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Laboratory coordination can repeat navigation across requests, availability and status.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked views can reduce retrieval of actual recorded context.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific priorities and resource conflicts require responsible coordination.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises when a nominally available resource cannot support the actual experiment.
tasks.altitude: Less status navigation; laboratory direction stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native laboratory/project views can link existing requests, resources and status; they do not establish actual availability or choose scientific priorities.

assumptions: Actual lab staff/instrument/material owners supply request identifiers, actual availability, status and timestamps. Biologist verifies these in s1; missing/outdated records require actual checking and no free availability capture is assumed.
Only repeated navigation loses time. Actual prioritisation, staff discussion, agreement capture and complete plan checking remain retained. Planned assignments do not establish completed experiments.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native views first; existing consolidated access earns zero saving. Actual written plan/delivery branches only; purely oral direction removes unused branches and reweights.

Commit/send each retain one percent using existing final check after actual plan exists. Assignments stay within actual authority; any separate experiment release decision remains actual work. Shared study planning and research records are counted once.
unknowns: How much laboratory status retrieval repeats?
research_questions: Can native views shorten preparation after actual availability verification?
